soma-1b.question: what has soma-1b shown: against a matched transformer on unseen text, on memory past its window, in learning after release, and at what training cost?
soma-1b.result: held-out bpb: transformer 0.950 frozen, 0.946 learning; soma-1b from its trained store 0.919 frozen, 0.916 learning; from an empty store 0.963 frozen, 0.937 learning. names read ~3,000 tokens earlier, outside the window: 37-66 bits before, under 2 after (one 89 to 18; control unchanged). about 2.4 billion tokens read in all; second billion of fineweb-edu 16.6 gpu hours, $44.55, training-stream score about 0.873. training speed on one H100 SXM: transformer 63.9k tokens/s, soma 38.4k with the trainer now released as runtime 1.6.1 (32.8k runtime 1.6.0 with speed settings, 12.9k first billion)

evaluation_protocol.weights_during_scoring: frozen; soma's store keeps counting what it reads
updated after each 1,024-token window is scored

dataset_and_exposure.preparation: soma-1b's pretraining also ran a source-prefix counting pass to seed per-lane stores; the transformer had none
dataset_and_exposure.evaluation: 100,009,572 bytes after the first 7.6 GB of the same stream; 26,607,616 tokens scored by each model in 8 lanes of 1,024
dataset_and_exposure.hash_status: held-out text sha256; training text sha256 aadfb60d8f0befcf5461873626e67d6590c3d1caab9ccb869ce55d0bc19bc46f

model_and_parameter_accounting.baseline: soma-1b's learner blocks with no store, cache or copy ring; each 1,024-token window starts fresh; AdamW, lr 1e-4 (best of 5e-5, 1e-4, 2e-4, 4e-4 on the first 50M tokens)

hardware_and_cost_scope.hardware: H100s on RunPod; second billion on one RTX PRO 6000
